title: Merchandise Purchases — Merchandise Class Schedule and Condition of Returned Goods
content:
**Merchandise Purchases** at Marlowe & Finch are grouped into seven merchandise classes. The class of an item is fixed by the department it is sold from, it is shown on every purchase record as the official class name, and it decides the return, price-adjustment and restocking terms of that unit.

## Schedule A — Class membership

| Merchandise class | Departments that place an item in the class | Further entry condition |
|---|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | women's, men's, kids', shoes, handbags other than designer handbags, accessories, intimates | none |
| Beauty & Fragrance | cosmetics, skincare, fragrance, hair and bath | none |
| Home & Kitchen | bed and bath, kitchen, dining, home décor, luggage | none |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | small appliances, personal electronics, smart home | none |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | fine jewelry, watches | at any unit price from $0.00 upward |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | designer handbags, designer collections | none |
| Furniture & Mattresses | furniture, mattresses, oversized rugs | fulfilled by home delivery |

## Schedule B — Condition required, final sale and personalised items

A returned unit is accepted only in the condition its class requires. Two further class terms state whether goods sold as final sale, and goods that are monogrammed, engraved or made to order, can be returned for a reason other than a defect.

| Merchandise class | Condition the returned unit must be in | Final sale goods returnable | Monogrammed, engraved or made-to-order goods returnable for a reason other than defect |
|---|---|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | unworn, unwashed, tags attached | No | No |
| Beauty & Fragrance | opened or lightly used goods accepted | No | No |
| Home & Kitchen | unused, in original packaging | No | No |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | with all accessories and packaging | No | No |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | unworn, with certificates and box | No | No |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | unworn, tags and authenticity card attached | No | No |
| Furniture & Mattresses | unused, unassembled or as delivered | No | No |

### Reading the schedule

- **Which column governs a unit?** The class printed on the purchase record. A handbag sold from the designer handbags department is a Designer Handbags & Luxury unit; a handbag sold from any other handbag department is an Apparel, Shoes & Accessories unit.
- **Furniture outside home delivery.** The Furniture & Mattresses class is defined by its departments together with home delivery as the way the item is fulfilled.
- **Beauty & Fragrance condition.** It is the one class whose condition term accepts opened or lightly used goods; every other class names an unused, unworn or complete-with-packaging condition.
- **Final sale and personalised goods.** Under every class the answer in both columns is No.
